newsitem.title: USA: MAI sees possible Q4 charge of $20 million.
newsitem.headline: MAI sees possible Q4 charge of $20 million.

text.p: MAI Systems Corp said Friday it may record a one-time charge of up to $20 million for the fourth quarter of 1996, principally relating to acquired intangibles.
The company also said it expects fourth quarter revenues to be about $16 million.

The potential charges relate to the elimination of intangibles and other non-cash write-offs associated with the completion of recent acquisitions, and may also include staff reductions and other operating expenses from the outsource of its field service operations to Olivetti North America.
Olivetti North America is an Olivetti & C SpA affiliate.
The revenue estimate was based on bookings of about $12.7 million for the quarter and a year-end backlog in excess of $12.0 million, they said.
These expectations compare with fourth quarter revenue of $17.0 million, based on bookings of $4.8 million and a year-end backlog of $3.0 million for the comparable period 1995.

MAI's previously announced revenue expectations for the fourth quarter of approximately $19 million were based on anticipated bookings of $8.3 million for the quarter and a year-end backlog of approximately $5.0 million.

The company said it attributed the increase in bookings and backlog and the lower-than-expected revenues primarily to higher demand for the company's products and services, a longer decision-making cycle on the part of its customers resulting in later-in-the-quarter bookings and longer-than-expected project implementation periods.
